reason: The mapping to Articles 11, 13, and 17 of the EU AI Act provides a defensible and sufficiently complete regulatory basis. Article 11 requires a technical file, which would contain architecture and tests. Article 13 mandates instructions for use, and Article 17 requires a declaration of conformity, which implies documented controls and approvals. Together, these provisions cover all aspects of the control statement.
applicability_note: This assessment applies to providers of high-risk AI systems as defined by the EU AI Act, which requires comprehensive documentation to ensure compliance and safety.
challenge_comment: The challenge lies in ensuring that the documentation is not merely a formality but a living record that accurately reflects the system's architecture, limitations, and operational controls throughout its lifecycle.
